# ePHPm active-pin manifest
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The single source of truth for WHICH image pins track the latest published
# ephpm/ephpm release. `.github/scripts/bump-ephpm-pin.sh` edits ONLY the files
# listed here, and ONLY the specific occurrences described by each entry's kind.
# Anything not listed is never modified.
#
# HARD RULE: this file must never list a historical/frozen pin. The historical
# suites are frozen on purpose (bumping them breaks the code paths they exercise
# or falsifies recorded results):
#   - pre-v0.7.0 rusqlite/sqld scripts:
#       db/bench-{engines,proxy,bridge,wordpress-bridge,admission}.sh, db/probe-*.sh
#   - scripts/run-db-bench.sh's HISTORICAL_IMAGE variable (v0.6.3) — the file is
#     listed below, but only its CURRENT_IMAGE var is active; HISTORICAL_IMAGE is
#     additionally protected by the script's built-in HISTORICAL_IMAGE skip guard.
#   - recorded-result markdown: DB-BENCH.md, docs/*, scale/reports/*
#   - rr/Dockerfile (RoadRunner competitor image, not ePHPm)
#
# Belt-and-suspenders: the bump script always skips any line containing
# `HISTORICAL_IMAGE` or the literal marker `ephpm-pin:historical`, even inside a
# listed file. To freeze a single pin inside an otherwise-active file, append
# `# ephpm-pin:historical` (or `<!-- ephpm-pin:historical -->` in markdown).
#
# Format (whitespace-separated, `#` starts a comment):
#   <kind>  <path>  <php-suffix>  [shell-var-name]
#
# kind:
#   manifest  Replace image-form pins `ephpm/ephpm:vX.Y.Z-<suffix>` on every
#             non-guarded line. Used for k8s YAML.
#   shellvar  Same replacement, but ONLY on non-guarded lines that assign the
#             named shell variable (`^\s*VAR=...`). Everything else in the file
#             (including HISTORICAL_IMAGE) is left alone.
#   prose     Replace image-form pins AND the bare current-pin version token
#             (e.g. `v0.10.8`) that matches the file's own image-form pin, on
#             non-guarded lines. Used for "current pin" documentation.
#
# The `-php<minor>` suffix of each pin is always preserved; only the vX.Y.Z part
# changes. k8s + prose pins are php8.4; the DB cluster suite is php8.5.

# --- k8s manifest pins (12 image pins across 7 files) -------------------------
manifest  k8s/krayin-v3.yaml         php8.4
manifest  k8s/laravel-v4.yaml        php8.4
manifest  k8s/opcache-cluster.yaml   php8.4
manifest  k8s/php-benchmark.yaml     php8.4
manifest  k8s/php-benchmark-v2.yaml  php8.4
manifest  k8s/runtimes-bench.yaml    php8.4
manifest  k8s/wordpress-v5.yaml      php8.4

# --- DB cluster suite pins (the only active db pins; php8.5) -------------------
shellvar  db/bench-cluster.sh        php8.5  IMG
shellvar  scripts/run-db-bench.sh    php8.5  CURRENT_IMAGE

# --- "current pin" prose ------------------------------------------------------
prose     README.md                  php8.4
prose     RUNTIMES-BENCH.md          php8.4
prose     k8s/OPCACHE-CLUSTER.md     php8.4
